Underweight.analysis: Your weight is below the healthy range for your height. Focus on nutrient-dense foods to gain weight steadily and healthily.

Normal weight.analysis: You're in a healthy weight range. Keep up balanced eating and regular activity to maintain it.
tips: Stay consistent with a balanced diet

Overweight.analysis: Your weight is above the healthy range. Small, sustainable changes to diet and activity can help you move toward a healthier BMI.
tips: Aim for a moderate calorie deficit

Obese.analysis: Your BMI falls in the obesity range, which carries higher health risks. A gradual, sustainable plan works best, ideally with guidance from a healthcare professional.
tips: Consult a doctor before starting a new routine
